quotes.text: My favorite boat experience in NYC ! Heading to the Statue of Liberty, passing by Governers Island and FiDi, we had plenty time and scenery to take awesome pictures -especially with the 7-9pm sunset package. We brought our own food and drinks, got provided with cups, water and seatings. You can walk freely on the boat and always come to the back, having a chat with Sam - our Captain. A really fun and nice guy to talk too.

Our trip with Captain Sam was incredible! We had a lovely sunset cruise in which core memories were made. We brought along some drinks and enjoyed the ride. We had a particularly windy night, to which Captain Sam checked in on our comfortability throughout the ride. We went for it!! Again, don't skip on this opportunity - 10/10 recommend!

We had a fantastic time sailing with North River Sailing! The sailboat was spacious and comfortable, and the BYOB policy made it even more enjoyable. Sam, our captain, was very professional, friendly, and ensured our safety throughout the trip. I would highly recommend North River Sailing over any other commercial options out there.

Thank you Captain Sam for being very professional and responsive! This sailing trip was great! 😊 The experience was so fun and the weather was beautiful on the day that we sailed. I will definitely recommend this sailing experience to all my friends.
We had a wonderful time sailing with Sam! We had incredible views of the Staue of Liberty, Governor's Island, Ellis Island, and Manhattan. The ride was smooth and very enjoyable!
There is a reason that Captain Sam has 5 Star Reviews from everyone. He deserves it. We had an amazing experience! Thank you Captain Sam.
